title: A and D Lancaster
memorial_details: Wall mounted, portrait orientated, plain brass plaque. A single line incised border surrounds a Latin cross at top centre, above the names and dedication. All detail is incised and picked out in black.
inscription: +/ In Loving Memory of/ Annie Lancaster,/ and/ Dorothy Lancaster,/ of Keelby Manor,/ WHO LOST THEIR LIVES THROUGH/ THE SINKING OF THE "LUSITANIA"/ 7TH MAY 1915.
community_connection: Annie Lancaster and Dorothy Lancaster, both from Keelby Manor
